title: Memory used by service helpers and list iteration
comparison: Each fwp service scope versus plain fwp state updates at 1/32/128 calls, O2, collection disabled. Managed requests, requested bytes and final charged storage from constant initialization through main cleanup. Fixed scheduler startup remains included in rows; per-call slopes subtract fixed costs.
limits: Service allocation rows exclude raw TLS/capture buffers, allocator metadata, pages and total process memory; they do not measure speed. Separate iteration_timing entries retain elapsed time and peak process memory when present. Neither comparison establishes C/Rust parity. Plain programs omit service fields; their task sizes are not the old service-task baseline. Whole services and remote results remain outside checked ARC support.

iteration.comparison: Old map-based each versus fold-based each, identical counting program and input list, O2 with collection disabled. Includes input construction, startup and printing; slope differences cancel fixed costs. Managed allocation requests and requested payload bytes only, not elapsed time or peak/process memory.
